commands.name: Back
commands.description: Return to the main Stream Deck keys.

commands.name: Buy
commands.description: Send your configured immediate Buy hotkey once, using the symbol, account, quantity and order defaults in the trading app.
commands.setup: In Setup > Application Settings > Hot keys > Active Trader, assign the Buy action. Match that hotkey here and verify its immediate-submit behavior in paperMoney. The app controls quantity, template and Auto Send.

commands.name: Sell
commands.description: Send your configured immediate Sell hotkey once, using the current trading app defaults.
commands.setup: Assign the Sell action in Active Trader hot-key settings, then enter exactly that hotkey here. The app controls quantity and Auto Send.

commands.name: OTOCO
commands.description: Open the editable entry, profit-target and stop-loss bracket. This button does not send the order.
commands.setup: This Java app does not expose its bracket picker to Windows accessibility on this PC. Configure an editor-opening hotkey only if supported. Otherwise select Active Trader > Template > TRG w/bracket in the app. This key never guesses a click or submits an order.

commands.name: Positions
commands.description: Show open positions in the app, including position size and profit/loss.
commands.setup: Uses the General hot-key binding. Change the override if you customized it. Positions and working orders share Monitor > Activity and Positions.

commands.name: Orders
commands.description: Show working orders and fills.
commands.setup: Uses the General hot-key binding. Change the override if you customized it. Positions and working orders share Monitor > Activity and Positions.

commands.name: Trade
commands.description: Open the Trade workspace. Select Active Trader there. Override if your General > Trade hotkey is customized.
commands.setup: Optional: enter a matching app hotkey for faster panel switching.

commands.name: Charts
commands.description: Show the chart workspace.
commands.setup: Uses Charts. Keep linked Daily, 5-minute and 2-minute charts visible together so the symbol stays synchronized.

commands.name: Level 2
commands.description: Show the Active Trader workspace containing your depth-of-market panels.
commands.setup: No working universal shortcut is available for this panel. Assign a supported matching app shortcut, or open it from the app.

commands.name: Time & Sales
commands.description: Show the trading workspace containing Time & Sales.
commands.setup: No working universal shortcut is available for this panel. Assign a supported matching app shortcut, or open it from the app.

commands.name: Watchlist
commands.description: Assign your Watchlist shortcut from the app hot-key settings.
commands.setup: No working universal shortcut is available for this panel. Assign a supported matching app shortcut, or open it from the app.

commands.name: Hot-key setup
commands.description: Open the app hot-key settings to configure your trading actions.
commands.setup: No working universal shortcut is available for this panel. Assign a supported matching app shortcut, or open it from the app.

commands.name: Focus app
commands.description: Bring the verified app window to the front.

commands.name: Chart settings
commands.description: Open chart settings with a chart selected. Match your app shortcut if customized.

commands.name: Time frame
commands.description: Open chart time-frame setup with a chart selected.

commands.name: Zoom in
commands.description: Zoom the focused chart in.

commands.name: Zoom out
commands.description: Zoom the focused chart out.

commands.name: Copy
commands.description: Copy in the app. An optional custom shortcut can replace the default.

commands.name: Paste
commands.description: Paste in the app. An optional custom shortcut can replace the default.

commands.name: Undo
commands.description: Undo in the selected editable field or editor.

commands.name: Redo
commands.description: Redo in the selected editable field or editor.

commands.name: Next field
commands.description: Next field in the app. An optional custom shortcut can replace the default.

commands.name: Previous field
commands.description: Previous field in the app. An optional custom shortcut can replace the default.

commands.name: Dismiss
commands.description: Dismiss a menu or dialog. Does not submit a form.

commands.name: Page up
commands.description: Page up in the app. An optional custom shortcut can replace the default.

commands.name: Page down
commands.description: Page down in the app. An optional custom shortcut can replace the default.

commands.name: Custom shortcut
commands.description: Set your own app shortcut, for example Ctrl+Shift+N.

commands.name: Trade
commands.description: Show the Trade Stream Deck page.

commands.name: Plan / Scan
commands.description: Show the Plan / Scan Stream Deck page.

commands.name: Manage
commands.description: Show the Manage Stream Deck page.

commands.name: Risk check
commands.description: Open your risk and position-sizing page. Configure its full URL.

commands.name: Trade plan
commands.description: Open your trade plan: daily trend, setup, entry, invalidation, target and size. Configure its full URL.

commands.name: Journal
commands.description: Open your trading journal to record the setup, execution and outcome. Configure its full URL.

commands.name: Trim 1/3
commands.description: Send your configured partial-exit hotkey. The broker must calculate one third of the current position and preserve or resize remaining protection.
commands.setup: Requires a supported, verified broker hotkey. This action has no guessed default. If your broker does not provide it, use Positions / Orders to manage it manually.

commands.name: Stop to B/E
commands.description: Send your configured stop-to-breakeven hotkey. The broker must derive the actual fill price and remaining quantity.
commands.setup: Requires a supported, verified broker hotkey. This action has no guessed default. If your broker does not provide it, use Positions / Orders to manage it manually.

commands.name: Trail stop
commands.description: Open the broker stop editor or send its configured trailing-stop hotkey. Review the remaining size and 5-minute structure.
commands.setup: Requires a supported, verified broker hotkey. This action has no guessed default. If your broker does not provide it, use Positions / Orders to manage it manually.

commands.name: Flatten
commands.description: Hold for one second to send the configured close-position action once. Match its cancel/close behavior in your broker.
commands.setup: Requires a supported, verified broker hotkey. This action has no guessed default. If your broker does not provide it, use Positions / Orders to manage it manually.

commands.name: Cancel orders
commands.description: Hold for one second to send the configured cancel-orders action once. Cancelling protective orders can leave a position unprotected.
commands.setup: Requires a supported, verified broker hotkey. This action has no guessed default. If your broker does not provide it, use Positions / Orders to manage it manually.

commands.name: Scanner
commands.description: Open Stock Hacker / Scan for your momentum watchlist. No options or orders are selected.
